findings.text: s16 requires "a pulse the archive returns without an end time is stored as open-ended, never with an invented end", but the delivered Pulse class carries `end_ns` with `required: true` (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:1929-1933), and s16 binds itself to "the archive, pulse and pulse category shapes section 3 added" whose declaration is that section is done, so a worker must either invent an end (refused by the control) or change the landed schema, which the section does not declare; the same required end makes the done-when's "number of pulses carrying both a start and an end time" a tautology equal to the total, a measure that cannot fail
